question: Can a continuous positive field metric built only from measured baryonic acceleration and tidal geometry redirect gravity more usefully than discrete return endpoints, and which small formula changes matter most?

weak_field_equation.equation: partial_i[K_b^ij partial_j Phi]=4 pi G rho_b
weak_field_equation.direction: Q_b is the normalized trace-free Hessian direction of the smoothed baryonic lens potential
weak_field_equation.symmetry: H=q_b^4/(q_b^4+0.05^4), where q_b is the flux-weighted global baryonic quadrupole asymmetry
weak_field_equation.conservative_projection: the response is solved as one scalar potential and its circular monopole is removed only when adding it to the already-radial locked raw-lens parent
weak_field_equation.positive_metric: matrix exponential keeps both constitutive eigenvalues positive for every scanned tau

physical_baryons.component: registered F160W stars plus physically projected ACCEPT gas with square-root Chandra angular morphology
physical_baryons.acceleration_proxy: softened three-dimensional Newtonian acceleration evaluated from the observed projected mass pixels
physical_baryons.scale_rule: Gaussian state-variable smoothing width equals eta times each system's measured baryonic R80
physical_baryons.known_limit: projected acceleration is not a deprojected three-dimensional cluster field; satellite stellar M/L and separately normalized ICL remain unavailable

factorial.identity: epsilon0=1 and tau=0 is the exact zero-metric control independent of a0, n, and eta

validation.screen: fit the zero-field geometry and source positions with eight starts, hold them fixed, and select the nonidentity candidate with minimum equal-system unweighted heldout source-plane RMS on the two selection systems
validation.exact: refit zero and the one selected candidate with eight starts on all four systems; require nonlinear heldout image roots
validation.spent_disclosure: all four clusters and SPARC are project-spent; the split is prospective only to P0586

cross_domain.galaxy: outside a spherical baryonic source the same scalar equation gives g=g_bar/epsilon(g_bar); tau is structurally absent when H=0
cross_domain.galaxy_data: 968 outer-holdout points in 131 SPARC galaxies with frozen inner-radius nuisance values
cross_domain.solar: evaluate the same spherical limit from 1.6 Solar radii through Saturn, at Earth, and in a first-order Mercury precession integral

claim_limits: This is a first-order projected weak-field constitutive test, not a completed covariant metric theory.
The raw-lens correction removes its circular monopole because the inherited scalar parent already fits a radial field; cluster amplitude is therefore not yet a standalone no-MOND prediction.
The SPARC calculation is the spherical exterior limit, not a full three-dimensional disk solve.
The ACCEPT gas maps lack shell covariance and the stellar maps lack resolved mass-to-light and separate satellite/ICL normalizations.
All observational systems are spent and no candidate can be described as independently validated.
